_comment: Phase 3 LinkedIn outreach defaults. Precedence: CLI flag > env var (LINKEDIN_DAILY_CAP, LINKEDIN_DRY_RUN, LINKEDIN_STATE_FILE, LINKEDIN_EMAIL, LINKEDIN_PASSWORD, LINKEDIN_SESSION_DIR) > this file. state_file is relative to scripts/ unless absolute. Account-safety: keep daily_cap at 15–20, delay_min/max_sec in the 15–45s band — this is what makes the machine look human and keeps ban risk manageable (see README).
